A '''junior officer''' served aboard the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] of the [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]]. Following the [[Battle of the Bajic Shipyards]], this officer tried speaking with [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], only to be cut off by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] mid-sentence, who [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinetically]] choked the officer momentarily, not wanting to be disturbed.
